entries.back_en: "Ah, you know that? Well now, that changes things, right?"
entries.note: 'isso muda as coisas' is a fine rendering of 'that's different then'.

entries.back_en: "I don't want this place to end up under a curse, like Chamba or Synesta—no deal!"
"Don't be afraid... I just want some information, that's all. You're going to tell me all about that monster you say you saw."
entries.note: 'I want you to tell me' softened to 'você vai me contar', meaning preserved.

entries.back_en: "Well!... I'd try to be a little more cooperative if I were you..."
"Otherwise... Things might get a little uncomfortable... And we don't want that, do we?"
"What do you think you're doing!?"
"The war's not over. A cease-fire was declared, that's all. Do you understand the difference, miss..."
"Wait... You're a Wyndian... Well well, if it isn't the little princess!"
"We were sent to find a dragon, but we found a little bird instead! Grab her, men—no reason we shouldn't take her too!"
entries.note: 'Pegam ela' should be 'Peguem-na'; informal/wrong imperative but understandable.

entries.back_en: "W...Wait! Do you know something about my sister...!?"
"By the power granted me, I command thee! Warrior spirit! You are summoned!"
entries.note: Faithful; archaic tone slightly modernized but ok.

entries.back_en: "Joh...I want you to capture that girl. Be careful not to hurt her...Too much."
"How gallant. You know it's a knight's duty to protect his lady, right? Where have you been all this time? Afraid, hiding in some closet or..."
"H...How dare you do this!? You filthy wretch..."
entries.note: 'fazer isso' and 'desgraçado' added but tone preserved.

entries.back_en: "I wonder if they'd use a curse against us if we went to war, like they did with Chamba and Synesta. Just thinking about it terrifies me!"
"I heard from a guy passing through that the Empire uses something called a Carronade to cast a curse on its enemies... Is it true?"
"munch munch munch"
"When you deal in contraband, you can't be too careful, eh?"
entries.note: 'nao pode ser cuidado demais' is ungrammatical; use 'cuidadoso demais'.

entries.back_en: "The valley is to the south of the town."
"I've heard rumors that there are Imperial troops here in town..."
entries.note: Missing opening quote mark; meaning intact.

entries.back_en: "I'm not af-afraid of mice! I-I just don't want to c-come down... That's all!"
